frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Koszegi-Rabin make the reference point the rational expectation of outcomes: gains and losses are felt relative to a reference lottery R, each outcome compared to every outcome that might have occurred; imposing that expectations equal actual behavior (personal equilibrium) sharply disciplines the otherwise free reference point.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Expectations-Based Reference Points
